easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
description:
Cast Trickery Charm by paying {U}, causing Pensive Professor to become either a Merfolk or Knight until end of turn.
Draw a card.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pensive Professor.
Pensive Professor triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3.
